paths.title: AI for Sales Professionals
paths.tagline: Personalize outreach at volume, follow up without sounding robotic, handle real objections, and draft proposals fast — without inventing a single fact about a prospect.
paths.description: A 6-lesson path for sales professionals covering the AI workflows that actually move pipeline: turning real prospect research into personalized cold outreach, building follow-up sequences that don't repeat the same ask, converting your own logged objections into practiced response scripts, drafting proposals and quotes from discovery notes without inventing scope or pricing, researching a prospect with cited sources before a call using Perplexity, and building a standing Claude Project as a reusable sales messaging library. Every lesson is built around the same core habit — keep the AI grounded in facts you actually know, and never let it invent a claim you'd have to walk back on a real call.

paths.title: AI for Recruiters & HR
paths.tagline: Write job descriptions and interview kits that work, source candidates who reply, screen fairly with real bias guardrails, and document policy without inventing legal claims.
paths.description: A 6-lesson path for recruiters and HR professionals covering the AI workflows that speed up hiring without cutting corners on fairness or compliance: writing job descriptions that attract the right candidates and flag exclusionary language, building competency-based interview question sets free of legally risky questions, personalizing candidate outreach from real profile details, screening CVs against stated criteria with explicit bias guardrails and a hard rule that humans make every decision, drafting HR policy documentation that flags anything needing legal review instead of inventing compliance claims, and mapping a full hiring workflow to decide exactly where AI safely assists and where it must stay human-only. Every lesson treats AI as a drafting and triage tool that speeds up a human decision — never as the decision-maker itself.
